description: ES256 with key_use enc fails with NoMatchingKey on a P-256 key that either part alone would select; decided by ADR 0054 §2.3 (purpose): key_use enc disagrees with the sig that ES256 implies, so the selector matches nothing; the member, a P-256 key without use or key_ops, matches ES256 alone and key_use enc alone; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
